thread:
lina: Heads-up - during the canary we saw ~0.8% 401s from token-cache misses when SA keys rotated. Anyone seen this before?
mike: yeah saw a small spike - looks like cache TTL + rotation window overlap. What is current TTL? config shows 5m.
anya: 5m seems fine for normal load but on rotation bursts it fails because exchange path tries old key -> fallback to org token -> rate limit.
lina: here's the flow I think: request->auth-proxy(cache)->if miss call key-service->if key expired fail -> fallback to proxy-token -> routed to org quota. We should probably add a circuit-breaker to avoid thrashing the key-service.
sam: +1 circuit-breaker. Also we need better telemetry in console: show per-key cache-miss rate and "fallback-to-org" counts as first-class metric.
ophelia: agree. Current dashboards only show 4xx/5xx by route, not by identity. Hard to debug quota storms.
mike: what about optimistic refresh? when key-service returns impending-rotation flag we prefetch new key before TTL ends.
anya: love that. Edge-case: multi-region failover - prefetch could cause extra load cross-region. Need policy: prefetch only if request-origin same region or if rank>100rps.
lina: UX question: how should console present this? Option A: per-key timeline with events (rotation, cache-evict, fallback). Option B: aggregated "auth health" score per project.
sam: I'd vote A for oncall, B for product view. Maybe both with drilldown.
deploy-bot: deploy started for canary/token-cache-policy v2 at 1718461200
mike: proposed implementation:
```
circuit-breaker:
  trigger: > 10% cache-miss * 30s
  action: short-circuit to stale-key for 15s
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window: 60s
  region-aware: true
```
anya: we must add telemetry tags: key_id, fallback_type, region, request_route.
lina: can someone mock a small dashboard panel? simple sparkline for fallback_rate and a pie for fallback_type.
ophelia: I'll whip one up in Grafana and a console mock tile. putting together now.
sam: also add a rollout plan: enable on dev, then canary 5% traffic 10min, monitor fallback_rate <0.1%, then ramp.
lina: thanks. if no blockers I'll merge PR for the circuit-breaker this afternoon.
mike: quick note—ensure audit log records when fallback-to-org is used (security needs that).
anya: yes will add audit event "auth.fallback" with key_id and reason.
ophelia: mock link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/authn-token-cache (just a working draft)
lina: perfect. tagging @security for visibility.
security: thanks for tagging — we'll review audit event shape before merge.
lina: merged PR 1718463000 - watch canary metrics.
deploy-bot: canary promotion completed at 1718463600
sam: early numbers: fallback_rate dropped 4x, cache-hit stable, no quota spike. :tada:
lina: awesome, closing thread for now. reopen if regressions.
